_comment: Engine room (#297). Every number is a starting value, TODO(initiator). reactor: the reactor (fission and turbine 0..100, output kW). auto_turbine_speed and auto_fission_speed are the Auto controller's target change per second: the turbine follows the load faster than fission is cut, so a load drop overshoots. room: the coolant pump and the junction box use the device values (device_core: max, repair_threshold, broken_below, factor_at_broken, fix times in s, required_skill, fail_chance, fail_cost, fail_lockout_s, wear_rate, wear_floor, wear_delay_s as a [from, to] range, idle_wear, overload_wear). grid: demand kW at full work, priority (higher is served first) and min_ratio (0..1, the share below which the group switches off).
